results.title: Coverage against a `kind`- or `urn`-filtered search
results.evidence: a search narrowed to one model answers 0 match(es) over 0 document(s) searched and 1 unread, while `GET /api/v1/document-search/coverage` — the figure the search's own detail line tells a reader to check first — answers 0.5 over 2 document(s) across the whole estate. `coverage()` takes no `urn` and no `kind`, and the route passes neither, so the two numbers are about different corpora and nothing
